generatedBy: tools/generate_plant_data.py from the recorded NPPAD runs behind data/scenarios.json; every series value was verified against the shipped scenario windows before writing.
displayNote: Series are shown at 20 s steps (every second recorded sample). Values are the recorded samples themselves, never interpolated.
diagnosisNote: Recorded predictions at the twin protocol: t0 = 100 s, W = 60 s, realistic channels. CNN and GRU were saved by the study only as aggregate scores, so no recorded per window prediction exists for them.
